t: 最终由现今的拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚组成的Terra Mariana成立.
te: Terra Mariana, eventually comprising present-day Latvia and Estonia, is established.

t: 英格兰国王约翰因为支持史蒂芬·朗顿大主教而驱逐了坎特伯雷僧侣.
te: King John of England expels Canterbury monks for supporting Archbishop Stephen Langton.
